datasets.name: MedHallu
datasets.description: Clinical QA hallucination benchmark assessing factual fidelity in diagnoses, pharmaceutical dosages, and medical guidelines.
datasets.focus: Clinical reasoning, contraindications, drug dosages, and guideline compliance.

datasets.name: RAGTruth
datasets.description: Word- and claim-level benchmark evaluating hallucination in Retrieval-Augmented Generation across healthcare, news, and QA.
datasets.focus: Evidence grounding, faithfulness to retrieved context passages, and retrieval contradiction.

datasets.name: HaluEval
datasets.description: Large-scale benchmark evaluating hallucination detection across general question answering, dialogue generation, and summarization.
datasets.focus: Disagreement with world knowledge, entity fabrication, and logical inconsistency.

datasets.name: CodeHallucinationDetection
datasets.description: Benchmark designed to catch hallucinated APIs, phantom library methods, deprecated arguments, and incorrect syntax generated by code LLMs.
datasets.focus: API correctness, non-existent packages, phantom functions, and false documentation claims.

datasets.name: PubMedQA
datasets.description: Biomedical question answering benchmark derived from PubMed abstracts, testing factual reasoning and conclusion consistency.
datasets.focus: Biomedical research claims, clinical trial abstracts, and conclusion faithfulness.

datasets.name: MedHal-LF
datasets.description: Evaluates hallucination rates in lengthy clinical outputs such as discharge summaries, clinical consultation notes, and multi-paragraph medical advice.
datasets.focus: Long-form clinical text, longitudinal facts, multi-sentence factual consistency.

datasets.name: CoDelusion
datasets.description: Benchmark designed to trap LLMs into invoking plausible but fictional packages, security vulnerabilities, and invented Python/JavaScript libraries.
datasets.focus: Package hallucinations, typosquatting plausibility, non-existent SDK methods.

datasets.name: PreciseWikiQA
datasets.description: High-precision factual question answering benchmark evaluating fine-grained numerical, historical, and geographical claims against Wikipedia ground truth.
datasets.focus: Exact date/location matching, census numbers, and historical treaty terms.

datasets.name: LongWiki
datasets.description: Assesses factual faithfulness when LLMs are tasked with extracting or reasoning across multi-thousand-token long Wikipedia articles with distractor passages.
datasets.focus: Long-context retrieval, distractor resilience, cross-paragraph entity resolution.

datasets.name: NonExistentRefusal
datasets.description: Tests model ability to detect and properly refuse questions containing false presuppositions, non-existent drugs, fictional laws, or imaginary historical events.
datasets.focus: Premise refusal, epistemic humility, avoiding sycophantic confabulation.

datasets.name: TriviaQA
datasets.description: Challenging reading comprehension and factual recall benchmark composed of complex trivia questions and evidence documents.
datasets.focus: Multi-entity factual recall, world trivia, and document-backed verification.

datasets.name: Natural Questions (NQ-Open)
datasets.description: Open-domain question answering benchmark composed of naturally occurring queries entered by real users on Google search.
datasets.focus: Unassisted factual question answering, concise answer spans, zero-shot entity precision.

datasets.name: SQuAD
datasets.description: Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD 2.0), featuring reading comprehension with both answerable and adversarial unanswerable questions.
datasets.focus: Textual entailment, unanswerable detection, and exact boundary extraction.

datasets.name: BioASQ
datasets.description: Expert-annotated challenge dataset covering biomedical semantic indexing, genetic pathways, rare diseases, and clinical research QA.
datasets.focus: Genomic associations, enzymatic mechanisms, and clinical evidence extraction.
